business_reason: Last month's repayment status is the most direct sign of current financial stress.
The worst arrears in six months captures past trouble even if the customer has since caught up.
August repayment status shows whether arrears are recent or persistent.
July repayment status adds history of missed payments beyond the last two months.
June repayment status adds older payment history.
May repayment status adds older payment history.
April repayment status adds the oldest payment history in the window.
Customers who repeatedly pay nothing are not servicing their debt, whatever their balance.
Paying little of last month's bill signals difficulty keeping up with the balance.
The credit limit reflects the bank's earlier assessment of the customer's income and creditworthiness.
The amount paid last month shows the customer's current capacity to pay.
The amount paid in August adds a second month of payment capacity.
